digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: Nineteen audited OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite their inputs and expected results being immutable to platform/version

The repo_policy marker must be registered and applied at function level to exactly 19 inventoried test nodes across seven mixed modules, excluding runtime and subprocess test cases that require cross-platform execution
The marked repo_policy nodes must execute only in the Ubuntu 3.13 default selection; all other default selections must exclude repo_policy via and not repo_policy selector
All unmarked test cases in the seven mixed modules must retain their original default selection behavior with no removal from any matrix cell
The workflow must maintain exactly two pytest sessions (default and integration), no new jobs or runners, and unchanged integration selector after routing the policy tests to Ubuntu 3.13 only
